Sessions: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6}–
Theme: TBD
Status: Active

The cocoon opened and the world breathed, but balance is not peace.
Renewal has awakened within the Shrine, yet ruin's passage has left scars no ceremony can heal — and now something is being forgotten at a scale larger than any single herald's curse.
Along the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall} the wards are failing, the faithful are vanishing, and the hero @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Ps9BeVM23C49daxv]{Sariel} is being unmade from memory and record.

The heralds are scattered and converging on the Bonewall, each finding the same rot wearing a different face.

Sessions

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Three Roads to the Bonewall — Roderic is charged to investigate the failing wards as the faithful vanish and Sariel is erased; Mira opens a Witch Stone portal onto the Bonewall and Garland and Castor follow; Paxton burns Senna's barge in the Reaches and learns the name Moldrex.
